_comment: Model prices in US dollars per million tokens, for INSPECT_AZUREAI_MODEL_COST_CONFIG. The repo's embedded model data carries no prices, so nothing is billed until a file like this is supplied. THESE ARE PLACEHOLDER LIST RATES: replace them with the rates on your own Azure and vendor invoices before quoting any figure. Foundry deployments are keyed by bare deployment name; direct calls by the prefixed Inspect name.
